Coverage_Description: Tailor-made employer plan with term life and hospital & surgical benefits; optional AD&D, LTD, TPD/TDI, supplementary major medical, clinical, dental and maternity coverage
customer requirement: Company enrolment minimum 3 employees; underwriting required for 3-9 insured employees, generally waived for 10+ group medical members
price structure: Tailor-made group premium, annual renewable; premium rates can be adjusted each policy anniversary
additional informations: Single combined life+medical policy or separate policies; optional conversion privilege to designated individual plans when employment ends
